description: This file defines the interface and class for a local storage component in a plugin framework, including methods for database operations such as opening a database, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entries, and modifying entries. It declares the LocalStore class implementing the ILocalStore interface within a specific namespace hierarchy.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: Implements the ILocalStore interface providing methods to manage local database storage, including opening databases, creating tables, setting data limits, retrieving entries, and maintaining database entries within the plugin namespace.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens or initializes the database at the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the database with the specified name.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of entries for a specific table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries in a table, starting from a position and up to a maximum count.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries from a table, starting from a position.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries from a table within a specified range.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a specified table.

methods.name: buildGetEventsQuery
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query string for retrieving events with given parameters.
